senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אֲשַׁן) [to recover strength, cmp. חָלַם,] to sleep, trnsf. to be idle, lazy.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 3:5">Shebu. III, 5</cite> (I swear) <he>שאִישַׁן</he> that I will sleep, <he>שיָשַׁנְתִּי</he> that I have slept.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>בא לִישָׁן</he> going to sleep.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:1">Cant. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>ישנתי לי מן התירה וכ׳</he> I (Israel) have been lazy in the study of the Law and the performance of good deeds; a. fr.
